data.name: Grimona
data.gender_notes: Grimona is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Grimos' meaning strong and 'Anna' meaning grace or favour. This name evokes images of a strong and gracious woman who works diligently to bring favour to those around her. The name Grimona carries the meaning “Strong, Gracious, Work” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grimona usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, gracious, work and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of strength and grace, symbolizing the inner power to remain faithful and humble in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Grimona belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Gracious, Work.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grimona total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Grimona carries a sense of strength and power, likely inspired by the Greek origin of the name. This may give the bearer a sense of confidence and determination. Additionally, the name's combination of the traditionally feminine name Anna with the strong and masculine Grimo adds an intriguing and unique edge to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Grimona symbolizes the fusion of strength and grace, showcasing the idea that one can possess both inner fortitude and delicate compassion. This name may inspire its bearer to be a beacon of support and kindness, as well as a force to be reckoned with. In Christian faith, this name may serve as a reminder of God's power and grace, which can be a source of solace and strength in times of need.
